title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 7: Shun Di
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．７ 「舜帝」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 7 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to the old master Shun Di. Newly made computer graphics show him dozing beside a lantern with his gourd, drifting on a river in a small boat, carrying water buckets on a shoulder pole and kicking through an autumn courtyard, in a sequence staged to his image song, a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Shun Di
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
